formation_structure.artillery_damage_budget: With supported ATK+6%, Steward deals 249.1 ordinary arts damage and 473.29 scaled damage against 50 RES. Forty-five uninterrupted attacks, including nine scaled attacks, total 13227.21. His [5,7] DOWN range contains column 7 at rows 2 through 5. Beginning near 72 seconds gives a static artillery-kill forecast near 143 seconds, conditional on survival and continuous acquisition.
formation_structure.beagle_budget: Five later upper-outer officers are the assigned load. At 330 ATK versus 490 DEF, each ordinary hit deals 16.5. A conservative 104-strike queue estimate consumes 1716 of 2035 HP. This is a packet estimate, not a verified survival result; artillery, an additional attacker or a longer queue would invalidate it.
formation_structure.compression: Omit Lancet. Move Midnight into Ansel's southern coverage, assign the initial upper-outer enemies to Melantha, and assign the five later upper-outer officers to Beagle.
formation_structure.cost: First deployments cost 114 DP. Melantha, Steward and Fang redeployments add 15+18+10=43 DP under the current executor. Living retreats refund 7+9+5=21 DP; gross expenditure is 157 and net expenditure before natural recovery is 136.
formation_structure.economy_dependencies: The ledger credits Fang's living grants at 570, 1320 and 2070, and Melantha's living seven-DP retreat refund at 2010. Their absence is a survival or handoff failure. Later deployment funding does not require additional Fang grants.
formation_structure.medical_limits: Neither medic covers Beagle or opening Melantha. Hibiscus receives ordinary healing only from herself. Central Melantha is outside both medical ranges and must attack behind Friston without acquiring blocking duty.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw Melantha after the opening upper thrower, upper officer and eastern upper roadblock are forecast cleared. No living hostile is intentionally released.
Spend the living refund on southern Steward, covered by both medics.
Place Beagle in the empty upper-outer lane, well before its next scheduled officer reaches this tile.
Redeploy Melantha behind Friston after 2131 frames off field; retain Midnight and Beagle in their permanent outer lanes.
Withdraw Steward after the forecast artillery and all central hostile clearance; retain him through the final armor rather than using an early caster rotation.
Withdraw Fang after forecast upper-central hostile clearance.
Return Steward after 2101 frames to destroy the western upper restraint.
Return Fang after 2101 frames to destroy the western lower restraint.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the eight listed normal-mode rarity-1-to-3 IDs may deploy; every listed ID is used.
Use integer [row,col] deployment tiles and explicit directions. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Melantha's upper withdrawal requires an empty hostile lane. Beagle does not inherit an already released enemy. Midnight never withdraws from the lower opening.
Opening Melantha survives without healing, Fang survives the credited grants, and both central holders survive until actual medical outputs occur.
Ansel covers Midnight, Friston and Steward; Hibiscus covers Fang, Friston, Ansel and Steward. Neither medic is credited with healing Beagle or central Melantha.
Steward must survive long enough to kill artillery. The 45-attack budget assumes uninterrupted acquisition and does not itself prove healing feasibility.
Melantha clears roadblock #3 before withdrawing; Midnight clears #4 before prolonged protected-target artillery exposure. No navigation shortcut or ordinary civilian blocking is assumed.
Friston remains deployed through armor #34's death. Melantha and Steward retain lower-central damage responsibilities until its actual clearance.
Scheduled living retreats have no hostile blocking load. A death gives no refund and releases blocked enemies. No same-ID emergency redeploy or action on an absent operator is assumed.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two protected-target arrivals. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four lanes, heal the southern holders, keep opening Melantha alive without medical coverage, and finish the eastern upper restraint before her withdrawal.

Survive the initial Ansel-centered artillery impacts. Each such impact can also hit adjacent Friston and Midnight. Both medics must restore actual HP between packets; deployment affordability alone does not establish survival.

Steward receives southern artillery under two medics. Hibiscus later receives northern artillery with self-healing and her timed skill. Beagle's upper lane must remain outside the artillery damage sequence.
Melantha removes lower armor and paired throwers while Friston retains capacity. Midnight maintains lower-outer interception and central crossfire. Preserve Steward's approach damage.
Kill final armor #34 while it remains blocked by Friston; finish upper residual armor and Beagle's officer queue. Do not count exhausted spawns as clearance.
Clear both western restraints after cooldowns, then allow both protected targets to reach their objectives. Require no remaining hostiles, no leaks and no protected-target deaths.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP; grants at 570, 1320 and 2070 are conditional on remaining alive and deployed.
Arts for the opening lower officer and restraint work, later lower officers and central armor, then residual clearance. Each repeat respects 40 active plus 70 inactive seconds.
Support the initial artillery recovery, renewed southern reception, paired-thrower overlap and residual clearance. Earliest readiness is 2071; no probabilistic extra healing is credited.
Concentrate the first boost on northern self-reception, then renewed pressure and the final central overlap. Earliest readiness is 2581; repeats require 20 active plus 30 inactive seconds.
After central redeployment, boost lower armor and paired-thrower damage, then residual armor #34 if still present. Earliest readiness after redeployment is 5341.
Ordinary blocking and damage suffice for the proposed officer budget. No unsupported dodge, self-heal or damage increase is credited.
Use supported highest-defense priority and automatic scaled strikes. No manual targeting is assumed.

tactical_thesis: Remove Lancet by reversing the outer-lane assignments: Midnight permanently holds the lower outer lane inside Ansel's ordinary healing range; Melantha opens the upper outer lane, clears its eastern roadblock, and withdraws from an empty lane before Beagle arrives. Melantha subsequently supplies lower-central damage. Two medics cover southern Steward, whose full-column artillery coverage avoids the V2 northern medical geometry. This is a complete static candidate, not a verified WIN.
